Consider the matrix $A = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 0 \amp -1 \\ -4 \amp 0 \\ \end{array}\right] $.

Describe what happens if we apply the power method and the inverse power method using the initial vector $\xvec_0 = \twovec{1}{0}$.

Find the eigenvalues of this matrix and explain this observed behavior.

How can we apply the techniques of this section to find the eigenvalues of $A$?
